quote: The standards of this section do not apply where mining is done on a flat or gently rolling terrain with an occasional steep slope through which the mining proceeds and leaves a plain or predominantly flat area; or where the mining is governed by § 716.3.
rationale: The exemption from the performance standards of this section is already accurately represented by exception record C0001, properly qualifying the baseline requirement C0000.

quote: unless the regulatory authority finds that the disturbance will facilitate compliance with the requirements of this section
rationale: The exception to the prohibition on disturbing land above the highwall is already fully represented by exception record C0005, which qualifies C0004.

quote: only when burial does not cause, or add to, instability of the backfill
rationale: The prerequisite condition governing permission to bury woody materials in the backfill is already captured by condition record C0008, qualifying C0007.

quote: when approved by the regulatory authority
rationale: The prerequisite condition requiring regulatory approval before chipping and distributing woody materials is already captured by condition record C0010, qualifying C0009.

quote: on natural slopes that exceed 20 degrees, or on lesser slopes that require measures to protect the area from disturbance, as determined by the regulatory authority after consideration of soils, climate, the method of operation, geology, and other regional characteristics
rationale: The governing slope conditions under which performance standards apply are already fully integrated into the baseline requirement C0000 and the scope fields of the standard-specific claims.
